entity.name: Giorgio Garofalo
entity.description: I'm Giorgio (iamgio), an Italian software engineer who has been in love with open source software for over a decade. I created Quarkdown in 2024 and have been its lead maintainer, developing its compiler, standard library, rendering engine, and tooling, as well as handling documentation, releases, and community support with the same passion as day one.

projects.name: Quarkdown
projects.description:
Quarkdown is a modern Markdown-based typesetting system designed for versatility. A single project can compile into a book, an academic paper, a knowledge base, a documentation website, or a slide deck.

It extends GitHub Flavored Markdown with a Turing-complete scripting system, which lets authors define, reuse, and customize their content. Documents compile to HTML, PDF, MD and TXT, fully offline, with a fast live preview, a community-driven package ecosystem, and a language server.

Funding helps sustain full-time development, maintenance, security fixes, documentation, and community support, keeping Quarkdown a free and open alternative to LaTeX and proprietary typesetting tools.
